language.title: Language
language.description: Programming language slug used by GitHub Trending, such as javascript, go, or rust.

spokenLanguage.title: Spoken Language
spokenLanguage.description: Repository description language code, such as en, zh, or ja.

loader.url: /trending{% if scope.params.language %}/{{ scope.params.language | url_path }}{% endif %}?since={{ scope.params.dateRange | url_query }}{% if scope.params.spokenLanguage %}&spoken_language_code={{ scope.params.spokenLanguage | url_query }}{% endif %}

publishedAt.template: {{ scope.value | regex_extract: '^[^·]+', 0 | relative_date_to_ms: 'Asia/Shanghai' | divided_by: 60000 | floor | times: 60000 }}

publisher.template: {{ scope.value | regex_replace: '^(?:刚刚|半小时前|几分钟前|[0-9]+(?:秒|分钟|小时|天|周|个月|月|年)前) · ', '' }}

artists.template: {% assign artists = scope.item.ar | default: scope.item.artists %}{% for artist in artists %}{% unless forloop.first %} / {% endunless %}{{ artist.name }}{% endfor %}{% assign album = scope.item.al.name | default: scope.item.album.name %}{% if artists and album %} · {% endif %}{{ album | default: '' }}

metadata.title: {% assign title = scope.page.title | regex_extract: '^(.+?)\\s*-\\s*歌单\\s*-\\s*网易云音乐$', 1 %}{% if title != empty %}{{ title }}{% else %}歌单 {{ scope.params.id }}{% endif %}

artists.template: {% assign artists = scope.item.ar | default: scope.item.artists %}{% for artist in artists %}{% unless forloop.first %} / {% endunless %}{{ artist.name }}{% endfor %}{% assign album = scope.item.al.name | default: scope.item.album.name %}{% if artists and album %} · {% endif %}{{ album | default: '' }}

metadata.title: {% assign title = scope.page.title | regex_extract: '^(.+?)\\s*-\\s*排行榜\\s*-\\s*网易云音乐$', 1 %}{% if title != empty %}{{ title }}{% else %}排行榜 {{ scope.params.id }}{% endif %}

url.title: Feed URL
url.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of an RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed.

url.template: {% if scope.item.type == 'answer' %}/question/{{ scope.item.question.id }}/answer/{{ scope.value }}{% elsif scope.item.type == 'article' %}https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/{{ scope.value }}{% else %}{{ scope.item.url }}{% endif %}

{% if scope.item.target.type == 'answer' %}/question/{{ scope.item.target.question.id }}/answer/{{ scope.value }}{% elsif scope.item.target.type == 'article' %}https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/{{ scope.value }}{% elsif scope.item.target.type == 'pin' %}/pin/{{ scope.value }}{% elsif scope.item.target.type == 'question' %}/question/{{ scope.value }}{% elsif scope.item.target.type == 'zvideo' %}/zvideo/{{ scope.value }}{% else %}{{ scope.item.target.url }}{% endif %}
